profile.name: x40-overlay
profile.description: PZTestKit + MoodleFramework + the staged NutritionRevamp copy (release/plan11-x40) + TKX_NmsStub + TKX_StudyFoods, fixture two, admin and bob, Nutrition off, DayLength 1, Overlay - x403, Plan 11b Task 4 session S4c.

harness_commits.016dce05: a ghost run restores its carrier's macros; time.snapshot reports the true multiplier
harness_commits.07c27dc4: the store probe formats tiny magnitudes with tostring (Kahlua %g hangs below 1e-292)
harness_commits.b932cbb2: moodle.watch (client) and moodle.level (server), Plan 11b Task 1 H1 and H2

meta.staging: python tools/release_pack.py stage mod/NutritionRevamp --out release/plan11-x40 (the controller, after Task 3c)
meta.stub_note: TKX_NmsStub is a 42/mod.info with name=, id=NutritionMakesSense and versionMin only; it puts the id in the activated-mods list and loads nothing.
meta.bus_note: The server answers the bus every 20 ticks (2 s at 10 Hz) or at a minute event (PZTestKit_Server.lua's tick poll and its EveryOneMinute poll).
meta.clock_note: DayLength 1: a game minute is 0.625 s of wall at true multiplier 1; no time.multiplier call in this driver.
